item.tib: zhi khro rdzu 'phrul dra ba dbal chen po gshed dmar spyi 'dul gyi rgyud las bzlog pa las kyi mdel thung
item.coloph: bzlog pa las kyi mdel thung*/ byad ma bsgral ba'i mtshon cha/ dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyi phyag cha/ thabs chen las kyi brnag pa u ya// ces nam mkha' snang mdog gis/ bla chen po dran pa nam mkha' la gdams pa'o/ sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i snyan du rgyud rgyud/ rjes 'jug skal ldan gshen po rnams kyi dngos grub/ bkra shis dge legs 'phel gyur cig
